messages.subject: Re: new user problems...
parts: As the message says (towards the end of your session output):

"Please install the latest GTK+ runtime from
http://gladewin32.sf.net/"

Have a look at

http://datamining.togaware.com/survivor/Installation_Details.html

for details.

Regards,
Graham
